meta.catalogoTitulo: Courses of the Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School
meta.catalogoDescricao: Free courses built only from lessons that already exist at Instituto Lúcia: basic, vocational and advanced, with estimated hours, syllabus and a printable zine.

catalogo.lead: Each course brings together lessons that are already written at the Institute, in modules and in a study order. Whatever has no lesson yet shows as under construction, with no link.
catalogo.selo: Course built only from finished lessons
catalogo.comece: Starting a long course? Begin with Learning to study.
catalogo.conteudoEmPortugues: The courses and lessons are in Portuguese.

basico.texto: To start or start again: studying, reading, writing, counting, science, history and languages.

profissional.texto: In alternation: school time with the lessons and work time with practical tasks.

avancado.texto: For those who already have the basics: political education and the ENEM path.

formatosTexto.regular: Modules of lessons, in study order.
formatosTexto.alternancia: School time (lessons) and work time (practical tasks), alternating.
formatosTexto.percurso: A short path that leads to other courses or pages.

curso.conteudoEmPortugues: The course content is in Portuguese.
curso.casoDoBairro: The final project can be a case from your neighbourhood.
curso.emConstrucaoTexto: These parts have no lesson yet. They join the course once the lessons are written.
curso.zineTexto: The summary, the words and the first question of each lesson, on A4 sheets that fold into booklets, with each lesson's QR code.
curso.turmasTexto: If you like, study together with others taking the same course.
curso.sensivel: This course is about politics. Your enrolment stays only on your device; to join a group, the School asks for your consent first.
curso.enem: Questions, mock exams, the diagnostic and the full plan are on the Institute's ENEM page.
curso.semRequisitos: No requirements: you can start now.
curso.recomendado: Recommended before any long course: Learning to study.

grade.tempoTrabalhoAviso: Do the tasks with the care taught in the lessons. Nothing on a live electrical installation, nothing without hygiene and nothing without the permission of the people involved.

horas.selo: estimate: reading + 2 min per question + 3 min per exercise
horas.noAparelho: Counted on this device, with the lessons you marked as done and the exempted tracks.

ementa.avaliacaoTexto: Formative, with no grades: feedback by competence at the end of each module, an optional track test, a task in the world and a final project presented to a panel.
ementa.bibliografiaTexto: The sources cited in the course lessons, without repeats, and the readings from the course library.
ementa.cargaTexto: {h} hours, over about {s} weeks at 3 hours a week. Estimate: reading + 2 min per question + 3 min per exercise.
ementa.naoOficial: It is an estimate for planning your study. The School is not a higher-education institution and does not award degrees.
